scope: Zero-training development-validation diagnostic; not final accuracy or promotion evidence.

data.internal_test: must not be resolved, hashed, opened, parsed or scored

aggregation.record_to_image: mean grounding and pointing records where overall is reported

primary_pass_rule: Each test requires mean>0, CI lower>0, Cohen dz>=0.2, Holm-adjusted p<0.05 and at least 2/3 positive seed means.

auxiliary_gates.S1: B grounding and pointing K48 correct-wrong retained-mass means are both >0
auxiliary_gates.S2: B K48 correct-wrong selected-set NDCG mean >0
auxiliary_gates.S3: B K48 correct-vs-wrong selected Jaccard mean <0.95
auxiliary_gates.S4: Prior contrastive report G1, G4, G5 and G7 pass and every pinned input SHA matches

decision_rule: OPERATIONAL_PROMPT_UTILITY_SUPPORTED iff P1, P2 and S1-S4 all pass; otherwise OPERATIONAL_PROMPT_UTILITY_NOT_ESTABLISHED.
